candidates.title: The Rooms Inside Noah’s Ark
candidates.narration: Detail number one: the rooms. Genesis tells Noah to make rooms inside the ark. Picture a divided interior, rather than one enormous empty space. The passage gives instructions, but it does not show us a complete building plan. Any illustrated arrangement of those compartments is an interpretation.

candidates.title: Noah’s Ark Had Three Levels
candidates.narration: Detail number two: the levels. The text names lower, second, and third stories, and places the door in the side. That means three levels, not simply animals standing beneath a roof. In our drawing, the cutaway makes those levels visible. Their exact internal arrangement remains an illustration, not something recovered from an ancient wreck.

candidates.title: Why the Ark Was Coated Inside Too
candidates.narration: Detail number three: the coating. The instruction is to cover the ark within and without with pitch. The inside matters too. Look at a wooden section: the coating belongs on both faces in this explanation, not just the outside of the hull.
